    RoutingProblem
    A built, immutable routing problem that yields a RoutingSolver (not just a generic Solver) so that firstSolution and improveWith are available without a cast.
    RoutingSolver
    Routing-specific solver that adds RoutingSolver.firstSolution(io.github.janglada.orkit.routing.Strategy) and RoutingSolver.improveWith(io.github.janglada.orkit.routing.Metaheuristic) on top of the shared Solver interface.
    StopConfig
    Fluent configurator for a stop, used inside the lambda passed to RoutingBuilder.stop(String, java.util.function.Consumer).
    Strategy
    First-solution strategy for vehicle routing.
    VehicleConfig
    Fluent configurator for a vehicle, used inside the lambda passed to RoutingBuilder.vehicle(String, java.util.function.Consumer).
